name: Claude Code
_comment: ENTER and CANCEL are handled specially by the bridge when an approval is
pending - they answer the prompt instead of running the actions below.
Agent keys are also bridge-handled (tap = focus, hold = interrupt).
Everything here is the fallback/normal-mode behaviour.
Claude Code's own keys do double duty for us: Enter submits AND accepts a
permission prompt; Escape denies a prompt AND interrupts a running turn.
So one physical key maps to one semantic action in every state.
_bridge_handled: KEY_AGENT1-4: tap = summon that tmux session fullscreen, hold = interrupt it
KEY_TERM: tap = launch launch_command here, double-tap = launch in a split, hold = new window
KEY_MIC: tap = send Space (voice-mode toggle in the chat prompt)
KEY_CANCEL: tap = send Escape (deny prompt / interrupt)
KEY_ENTER: approve when a request is pending, hold = sessions overview
_launch_note: 'cla' is a shell alias. tmux send-keys types into an interactive shell, so aliases and functions resolve normally - unlike exec-style launching, which would not see them.
